title: Neymar steps up, trains on the pitch with Santos - NewsBreak
text:
By OneFootball ,
1 days ago
Neymar steps up, trains on the pitch with Santos | Image credits : Getty Santos provided an update on the physical condition of its squad during training this Friday at CT Rei Pelé, with a focus on preparations for the derby against São Paulo in the next round of the Brazilian Championship.
Head coach Cuca oversaw physical activities followed by tactical work on the pitch.
Below is an overview of the players who are under medical care or returning to the team, according to ge.
Neymar: The attacking midfielder began transition work on the pitch, taking part in activities without contact with the rest of the squad. He is recovering from a grade 2B muscle injury to the rectus femoris in his thigh. To have him available for as many matches as possible in the final stretch of the Brasileirão, the coaching staff does not intend to rush his return, making him an almost certain absentee for Friday’s derby. Benjamín Rollheiser: The midfielder trained normally with the group. He had missed the team’s win over Remo last Saturday and Thursday’s return to training due to a severe viral illness. Álvaro Barreal: Like Neymar, the Argentine forward is doing transition work on the field as he recovers from a left thigh injury. However, he is at a more advanced stage and has a chance of being included in the squad against São Paulo. Willian Arão: The player is doubtful for the match. He is being treated for pain in the internal oblique muscle of the abdomen and has been undergoing physical therapy sessions twice a day (at the training center and at home). If he is fit to play, he is the main option to replace center-back Luan Peres, who is suspended. The Santos squad will return to training on Saturday morning to continue preparations.
